spellbook.finance/limitations: This records recovered units only. It does not assert a new purchase, paid price, or exact historical recovery date.
incrementalCashCostUsd is zero. allocatedParentBasisUsd is null because no parent purchase entry was identified or allocated.
eventAt is null. The reported timing estimate is approximate, about one month before recordedAt; recordedAt is the exact intake timestamp.
missingFields names the parent entry, allocated basis and exact recovery date that remain unknown. It never adds card singles or touches pending receipts.
The operation is limited to product ids 618698 and 579917 with quantities bounded by the confirmed recovered counts.

description: Record sealed packs recovered from already-opened products, without adding a new purchase or guessing their share of the parent product's cost. This bounded intake accepts the confirmed Aetherdrift Box Topper and Modern Horizons 3 Collector Booster Sample Pack products. It records zero incremental cash, keeps parent basis unallocated, marks recovery timing approximate, and returns persisted-row readback. Reuse requestId unchanged after a timeout.

hold.description: True marks these units as held from listing; false leaves them unheld. Required.

productId.description: Exact TCG sealed pack product id: 618698 for Aetherdrift Box Topper, or 579917 for Modern Horizons 3 Collector Booster Sample Pack. Required.

quantity.description: How many recovered units to record: up to 11 for product 618698, or exactly 1 for product 579917. Required.

requestId.description: Stable idempotency key for this recovery entry. Reuse this exact value to retry. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to add recovered sealed components to. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_recovered_component_record
